product.title: Dinner Cookout Ride at Heart Six Ranch

description.text: Ride a horse outside Grand Teton National Park with Heart Six Ranch near Jackson Hole. Experience a once-in-a-lifetime horseback ride in an area not accessible to most. You and a small group will ride along a tranquil river trail, enjoying the beautiful natural surroundings and mountain views. Ideal for travelers basing in Jackson Hole who want a guided Wyoming outing without self-driving mountain roads.
